title: Fix the board's held-width line, mode label and name from the operator's 0.13.0 re-test (seq 243)
description: Operator re-test of opum-ai/quest-cli#486 at 5705477b did NOT pass (relayed by opum-doc as seq 243, ODOC-OP-2026-10-03-74, recorded on opum-agent OPAG-1086/OPAG-1074). Three items on the #486 branch: (1) the DEC-154 rule 3 held-width line never rendered on the operator's client even though pluginPanes.dockColumns is kept -- the line waited on a draw after the ask, and a surface that keeps its width has no reason to repaint; it now renders on the ask's own draw when that draw is short of the ask, and a granting surface still clears it on the answering draw; (2) the full toggle label named the action ('Normal size') and read as the current state -- it now reads the current mode with the key as a hint ('Normal · z for full' / 'Full · z for normal'); (3) the operator's rename: pane title, tool lines and band read 'Quest', not 'Quest board'. The 0.13.0 bump and pair release stay HELD (OPAG-1086 AC3); do not merge, promote, tag or publish.
implementationNotes: SEQ 243 FIXES DONE, 2026-10-03, commit 3968d23e on chore/QCLI-433-bump-0-13-0 (#486 head). CAUSE, MEASURED (item 1): the held-width line rendered only on a draw AFTER the full ask -- the draw that made the ask was suppressed (owesFullAsk), and a surface that keeps the width a person set has no reason to repaint the pane, so the suppressed draw's tree stood and the line never appeared; the dashboard tool could still read holding=true from that later draw, which is why the tool said 'the width is kept' while the pane showed nothing. Rendered-pane evidence: with an instrumented probe copy of the unfixed 5705477b build, staged at the operator's client shape (config-toggle-kept: pluginPanes dockColumns=80, stored full view, tmux 200x50, stock 2.1.288 client), the probe's FIRST render -- the ask's own -- read notice=null holding=false, every later render carried the line; under the fix the first render reads notice='Width kept at 80 (you set it): drag the pane edge to change' and the capture shows it. Not reproduced on the stock client in any flow (start, /reload-plugins, tool, toggle); the operator's session runs the cc-patch teammate-workflow build (same 2.1.288 string, different bytes) and views via Remote Control -- recorded so a recurrence can name it. FIX: holding = inFull && awaitingGrant && (!owesFullAsk || isShort); a draw already at the ask's size claims nothing, and a granting surface still clears the reading on the answering draw. ITEM 2: the full toggle reads the current mode as state with the key as a hint ('Normal · z for full' / 'Full · z for normal'); the action-naming labels and surfaceKeepsSize are gone. ITEM 3: pane title, dashboard tool lines, band, tool description and deny lines read 'Quest'. PROOF: mod suite 46 pass / 0 fail (new pins: the line on a stored full mode's first render, the mode labels, the title); the four pre-existing board.test.tsx tsc errors (QCLI-451) unchanged; lint, format:check, typecheck, layer:check exit 0; real-pane capture screen-retest3-fixed-0-start.txt and probe.retest.jsonl under /tmp/qcli-probe (instrument-retest.py, run-retest.sh). The 0.13.0 bump and pair release stay HELD (OPAG-1086 AC3): no merge, promote, tag or publish.
finalSummary: Rendered the board's held-width line on the ask's own draw (it previously waited on a repaint a width-keeping surface has no reason to make -- the operator's missing line), made the full toggle show the current mode with the key as a hint, and renamed the pane and its tool lines to Quest. Verified in the mod suite (46 pass / 0 fail, with new pins) and on a real pty against the operator's client shape (probe JSONL + capture: the line on the first render, 'Full · z for normal'). Commit 3968d23e on chore/QCLI-433-bump-0-13-0; #486 head; the 0.13.0 bump and pair release stay HELD.
